title: Chapter 2 · The street songs
description: song-sad plays in Passatge Maresme, and song-concrete on Meridiana street: bar 1, then bars 2 to 17 vamping two to four times before the rest of the song, and over again from bar 1. The overlay is the scenario's, not the game's: it prints the song and its position. It plays from 34 s so the vamp wraps back to bar 2 (2.18 s), then moves on past bar 18 (37.09 s). It plays music, so run it with --chrome: just screenshots street-music --chrome.

steps.eval: window.showMusic = () => { let el = document.querySelector('#music-check'); if (!el) { el = document.createElement('div'); el.id = 'music-check'; el.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:16px;bottom:16px;z-index:99;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;background:#000c;color:#ffd6ec;font:14px/1.4 monospace'; document.body.append(el); } const m = window.gerard.music; el.textContent = `♪ ${m.playing} · ${m.position()?.toFixed(2)} s`; }

steps.caption: Passatge Maresme: song-sad, looping whole (0 → 96 s)
